egfr.pdb_note: 1M17 = EGFR kinase + erlotinib, MATURE-protein numbering (offset -24, clinical T790 = residue 766); 4ZAU = WILD-TYPE EGFR + osimertinib, clinical numbering (offset 0). 4ZAU is not T790M: residue 790 is Thr, verified by pipeline.pocket.validate_references(). Pocket geometry source.

abl1.numbering: ABL1a numbering. UniProt P00519 (1130 aa) agrees at offset 0, verified against Thr315/Tyr253/Glu255/Gly250/Met351/His396.
abl1.numbering_warning: Two conventions exist: ABL1a (gatekeeper Thr315) and ABL1b (+19, same residue is 334). The DMS, UniProt P00519 and PDB 1IEP/2HYY all use 1a at offset 0, but PDB 1OPJ carries the same imatinib ligand at offset +19 - substituting it silently returns the wrong residue.
abl1.pdb_note: Both hold imatinib as ligand STI at offset 0. 1IEP is the pocket-geometry source.
abl1.assay: Ba/F3 net growth rate at 1200 nM imatinib, 6 days, TileSeq + duplex sequencing

rice_als.numbering: ALS resistance literature uses ARABIDOPSIS numbering (A122, W574, S653). Rice Q6K2E8 is 26 residues shorter.
rice_als.numbering_warning: A122 is alanine in BOTH numbering systems by coincidence, so testing only A122T hides the bug. W574 is Asp in rice numbering and S653 is past the 644-residue end. Always renumber.
rice_als.pdb_note: Arabidopsis ALS structures. Rice ALS must be aligned to these; they contain related but not identical inhibitors, so pocket distances are APPROXIMATE and must be recorded as such.
rice_als.assay: fresh shoot biomass GR50, 21 days post-treatment
